context.body: Gospel, Israel, and shared life · Romans 3:21–31
context.label: Gospel, Israel, and shared life

observations.body: Righteousness is disclosed apart from law. But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets; Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
observations.label: Righteousness is disclosed apart from law

payload.posture: Read Romans 3:21–31 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states righteousness is disclosed apart from law. But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets; Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
payload.title: Righteousness is disclosed apart from law
